entities.summary: The Osaka Prefectural Government Sakishima Building  or Cosmo Tower  is the third tallest building in Osaka and the sixth tallest building in Japan. Until 2023, it was known as Osaka World Trade Center Building  or WTC Cosmo Tower . It is located in Nanko Cosmo Square, near the Osaka harbor, in Suminoe-ku.
